title: From the Vault: Dragons: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Cleansing the world, one breath at a time.
Dragon whelps face few threats besides their own enthusiasm.
Dragons come not in packs or in herds but in storms.
"The dragon wing of night o'erspreads the earth." —*Troilus and Cressida*, William Shakespeare
"The dragon has no pretense of compassion, no false mask of civilization—just hunger, heat, and need." —Sarkhan Vol
The fall of the evening star never heralds a gentle dawn.
As brilliant as a cut diamond, and with just as cruel an edge.
The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.
Sometimes primitive cultures attributed natural phenomena to monsters. Sometimes they were right.
